name: PLSC 3245
title: Plant Breeding and Biotechnology
description: Principles and applications, economic, social and environmental impacts, advantages, potentials and limitations of major traditional and modern plant breeding technologies including crossing/hybridization, mutagenesis, genetic engineering and genome editing. Formerly offered as SPSS 3245.
requirement_description: One of BIOL 1102, 1108, or 1110; or MCB 2410; or PLSC 3210, 3230, or 4210.
